title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass - Carolina Collection | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a guest towel holder that keeps hand towels and washcloths within easy reach, featuring a stable, freestanding countertop design crafted from solid brass in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms.

  • Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Heavy base helps prevent tipping on the countertop
  • Felt pad helps protect countertop surfaces from scratches
  • Coordinates with the Carolina collection for a cohesive look

Specs

  • Category: Guest towel holders (freestanding towel stand)
  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Dimensions: 16.3-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Freestanding towel holder
  • Multiple designer finishes available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Guest Towel Stand
_previous.description: This elegantly crafted vanity top guest towel stand will add style and convenience to your bathroom décor. Guest towel stand has two arms to keep your towels within reach of the sink where they are needed. Guest towel stand was designed ideally for hand towels and washcloths. Heavy base will help prevent stand from tipping and felt pad on bottom will protect countertop surfaces.
